purpose: Teach: 渦/大雪/鮨/呪文/電灯/コンセント/キノコ/ハンバーガー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、海の渦のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer was telling me about sea whirlpools today.
lines.style: Warm recollection, unhurried pace. Soft opening—offering a small memory like a gift. Gentle eye contact, the cadence of someone sharing something that caught her attention. No rush.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、明日は大雪の予報ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The forecast is saying heavy snow tomorrow.
lines.style: Practical observation stated with gentle concern. Clear, measured tempo. The tone of someone thinking ahead for both of them—what it might mean. Not worried, just aware.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、近所の鮨屋に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of your regulars went to the sushi place nearby.
lines.style: Light, conversational setup. Slight lift of interest in the delivery—noticing what Aoi might care about. Unhurried but present. The ease of two people who know each other.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様に呪文を唱える絵本読まれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer was reading their child a picture book about casting spells.
lines.style: Soft smile underneath the words. Nostalgic, almost tender—the image lingers. Slower tempo on the second half. The quiet delight of noticing something small and genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の電灯、新しいLEDに換えましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should replace the shop lights with new LEDs.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, not directive. Opening with ease, building to purpose. Attentive to practical care of their shared space. Collaborative tone—inviting her into the decision, not deciding for her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、コンセントを増やす工事を頼みたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've been thinking we should have someone come add more outlets.
lines.style: Quieter admission of a want. Like she's been sitting with this thought. Softer attack, then steadier—practical but tinged with the small vulnerability of naming a need. Conversational, not commanding.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、キノコのスープ加えましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We could add a mushroom soup to the new menu.
lines.style: Gentle enthusiasm, but grounded. Opening with possibility, not insistence. Bright without being loud. The warmth of someone who listens to what works and wants to build on it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お子様、ハンバーガーを選ばれたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of the kids came in and chose a hamburger.
lines.style: Quiet observation, the softest landing. Small, genuine smile in the words. Trailing off slightly—the contentment of a simple, true moment. Like she's still holding it gently.
